LanguageData.AR_EnableStrategy: Raiders switch strategy against kill boxes
LanguageData.AR_EnableStrategyTip: Once a faction has lost enough pawns in one place, its raids are more likely to use sappers, breachers, siege or drop pods.
LanguageData.AR_EnablePathingTip: Adds extra path cost to cells where the faction's pawns died, so assaulting raiders walk around them when they can.
LanguageData.AR_IncludeMechsTip: Off by default. Mechanoids are machines on a mission and do not learn.
LanguageData.AR_MinDeaths: Deaths in one spot before a faction learns
LanguageData.AR_AvoidMin: Chance to avoid at first lesson
LanguageData.AR_AvoidMax: Chance to avoid when well learned
LanguageData.AR_DropChance: Chance of a drop pod arrival instead of walking in
LanguageData.AR_HalfLife: Days for a lesson to fade by half
LanguageData.AR_Radius: Radius of heat around each death (cells)
LanguageData.AR_PathCost: Path cost per unit of heat
LanguageData.AR_PathMax: Maximum extra path cost per cell
